Definition
[Weak partial derivative] 1. ch5:5.2-def-1\group Sobolev Spaces Suppose $u, v \in L^1_{\text{loc}}(U)$, and $\alpha $ is a multiindex. We say that $v$ is the $\alpha ^{\text{th}}$-weak partial derivative of $u$, written \[ D^\alpha u = v, \] provided \[ (3) \quad \int _U u D^\alpha \phi \, dx = (-1)^{|\alpha |} \int _U v\phi \, dx \] for all test functions $\phi \in C_c^\infty (U)$.
